shortDescription: Polymarket odds for the US Open WTA match between Iva Jovic and Alexandra Eala swung sharply, with the Iva Jovic option falling from 73.5% one hour ago to 44.5% at present. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects a 29% drop in the submarket and may be tied to breaking news affecting the event.
